answer: A driving licence check gives a crystal-clear view of who is behind each agent. A new agent binds its key to a full licence checked via the DVLA share code, which returns photo, categories, and penalty points at once. The licence stays bound to that key, so points or a ban follow the agent and a fresh identity cannot wipe its record. Forging 1,000 agents means passing 1,000 driving tests at about £1,000 each in lessons and fees, plus months waiting. A farm facing that check is a gardener planting a thousand lotus on one terrace: only so much soil, and every plant needs its own roots.
